title: Someone deactivated on release day stays off after reactivation
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as an Admin of the production test account, at its test location, Trucks Hill 2.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a new staff member for this test on production, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to Yes, enrolled at Trucks Hill 2, and deactivated with Deactivate Account (written down with a screenshot of the staff record).
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings, Staff.
  2. Click the "Deactivated" tab.
  3. Click Reactivate for staff member A.
  4. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  5. Open Work Orders, Board View, at Trucks Hill 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The staff list shows.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A's row shows "No" in the Technician column.

Step 3:

  • Staff member A is on the Active tab and their row shows "No".

Step 4:

  • Technician is off.

Step 5:

  • Staff member A has no column: they are not offered until Technician is turned on for them.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11884 (Story 6, Release day)

  • S6-E3: “A staff member who is deactivated, or has Time Clock off, at the moment the step runs starts with Technician off. Turning Time Clock on later does not turn Technician on (S1-R5). A seasonal technician who is deactivated on release day and reactivated later is not offered on any technician list until the shop turns Technician on for them.”
  • S6-R1: “Technician is turned on for each staff member whose user is active, whose Time Clock is on and who has a role other than the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, when they meet any of these, at any location of their organization:”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs the before values taken on production shortly before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
